author: Josephs, Lewis S.
title: Palauan reference grammar
notes: With the assistance of Masa-aki Emesiochel, Masaharu Tmodrang and Helen Wilson. Consulted directly on 25 November 2026 (chapter 1 in Downloads, from page images and OCR). Josephs's phonemes are those of Blust (2009) without the glides (his long vowels ii, uu, ee, oo are [iy], [uw], [ey], [ow], p. 23) and with d for Blust's ð.
